uncovered_shapes.sentence: According to data from the automotive research platform iSeeCars.com, the Cybertruck was the fastest-selling used pickup in the United States in October.
Tesla registered a record 285 Cybercabs in one day, bringing its Texas total to 1,107, according to data from the Texas DMV.

claims.claim: Ontario Premier Doug Ford said on X on Thursday that he has written to British Columbia Premier Lorne Doerkson, urging him to immediately follow through on his promise to scrap the province’s electric vehicle (EV) sales mandate, citing concerns over Canadian auto industry jobs.
